tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Dark purple hero at the top of Today and Trips, the laptop top bar and the first open screen. Text on it is white or hero-text.

tokens.name: hero-text
tokens.usage: Labels and dates on hero, like Leave China by and Sun, Oct 18. Passes 8.5 to 1 on hero.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The filled part of the countdown ring on hero. Graphic only.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fills only. The main button, the add button, the Now chip, timeline dots, bars, the selected tab icon. White text on it passes 6.8 to 1.

tokens.name: purple-text
tokens.usage: The only purple for text. Selected tab, Edit, links, Now · 20 days left, text on soft. Passes 7.9 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Soft purple fill for icon tiles and bar tracks. Text on it uses purple-text.

tokens.name: current
tokens.usage: Background of the row or card for the stay or trip you are in now.

tokens.name: current-line
tokens.usage: Border of the current card and the halo around the current timeline dot.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen and sheet background. Warm off white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and the selected segment.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and values. 15.4 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, secondary values, notes, section labels, inactive tab. 5.0 to 1 on bg and 4.8 to 1 on current.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers between rows, the segmented track.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Grey box behind quiet notes, like the note on a finished stay, and the round close and back buttons.

tokens.name: chip-text
tokens.usage: Text in a chip box. 5.7 to 1 on chip.

tokens.name: chevron
tokens.usage: Row chevrons, always next to a text label. 3.7 to 1 on surface and 3.2 on current so the icon itself is visible.

tokens.name: done-dot
tokens.usage: Timeline dot for a finished stay.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Graphic attention only. The tax bar close to its limit. Never text.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: The only coral for text. Every warning line and the rules to check chip. 5.8 to 1 on bg and 5.6 to 1 on coral-soft.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the rules to check chip and the coral days chip.

tokens.name: coral-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of a coral bar.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet on phones. On laptops it is the same color at 72 percent over the page.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one big line on a screen. The answer, the ring number, the Trips title, the first open headline and empty states. 44 on laptops.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Stay dates, country names, buttons, sheet titles and the laptop brand.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Row labels, values, hero labels, tabs and links.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels above cards, eyebrows and phone tab bar labels. Sentence case, no caps.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Tap a stay to match your flights.
styles.usage: Notes, chips, status, warnings and the second line of a trip row.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between two lines of a warning row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a section label and its card, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between the lines in the hero stack and between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside cards and rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Above each section label.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side margin on every phone screen and sheet.

tokens.name: max-width
tokens.usage: Content width on laptops. Hero colour runs full width, content sits inside this.

tokens.name: radius-note
tokens.usage: Grey note boxes.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped rows. Things you read.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a sheet on phones, all corners on laptops.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, switches, round buttons, the ring. Things you tap.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The selected thumb of a segmented switch. The only shadow in the app.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom action button.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a one line row.

tokens.name: size-ring
tokens.usage: The countdown ring on hero.

tokens.name: size-fab
tokens.usage: Round add button.

tokens.name: size-nav-button
tokens.usage: Round close and back buttons at the top left of a sheet.

tokens.name: size-round
tokens.usage: Round buttons on hero, like settings and export.
